import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/data/body-size-evolution-in-south-american-freshwater-fishes.csv')
df.head()

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np

# Select the relevant evolutionary traits
evolutionary_traits = ['BEL_evol', 'MBL_evol', 'OGP_evol', 'RES_evol', 'RML_evol']

# Prepare the data for regression
X = df[evolutionary_traits].values  # Predictor variables
y = df['BAMM_speciation'].values  # Response variable

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.coef_

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Select the relevant evolutionary traits
evolutionary_traits = ['BEL_evol', 'MBL_evol', 'OGP_evol', 'RES_evol', 'RML_evol']

# Prepare the data for regression
X = df[evolutionary_traits].values  # Predictor variables
y = df['BAMM_speciation'].values  # Response variable

# Add a constant to the model (intercept)
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Create a linear regression model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# Get the summary of the model
model.summary()
